releaseNotes: New: Auto Push under Settings -- configure SMS (Twilio) and Email (SMTP) directly in the app instead of editing .env, plus a Customer Database (renamed from Subscribers, now with a name field). Fixed: Send Now used to silently report success even when nothing was configured; it now tells you plainly if SMS/email aren't set up. Removed Scheduled Ads -- the flyer switcher already shows the same dates/status on actionable cards.
